findings.summary: Guided Chat is not a specialized conversational proposal/explanation surface and user-template duplication is missing.
The repository trusts caller-supplied semantic changes instead of reconstructing the base and authorizing the exact server-computed diff.
Production resolution uses one hard-coded contender rather than actual task/applicable instruction sources and does not update the content-free session record.
Review/stale-check/write is not serialized or compare-and-swap safe, permitting concurrent lost updates.
Valid screenshot-heavy archives or ordinary user text mentioning raw audio can be rejected and disappear from History.
Export staging/backup state is not durably recoverable, full ancestor confinement is not verified, and hard interruption can leave plaintext or displaced destinations.
Blacklist redaction permits secret-bearing values/unknown fields and Markdown content to enter plaintext exports.
Delete-all uses the filtered catalog, UI manufactures confirmation, and concurrent operations can overwrite the single journal intent.

mutableTargets: prompt composition and session snapshot integration

deltaReview.scope: IC-M04-B01 through IC-M04-B08 plus regression of previously passing criteria
